spans.s: द्वि num. (nom. du. द्वौ m., द्वे f., द्वे n.) Two, both. (in compounds, द्वा is substituted for द्वि before some numerals, and before ज and पर).
द्वि-ककार m. 1. a crow (there being two kas in the word काक); 2. the ruddy goose (there being two kas in the word कोक).
द्वि-ककुद् m. a camel.
द्वि-गु (I) m. one of the four compounds in which the first member is a numeral (in gram.), e.g. द्विगु.
द्वि-गु (II) a. bartered for two cows.
द्वि-गुण a. double, two-fold.(द्विगुणाकृ ‘to plough twice.’)
द्वि-गुणित a. 1. doubled, multiplied by two, Kir.v.46; 2. folded.
द्वि-चरण a. having two legs, two-legged, द्विचरणपशूनां क्षितिभुजाम् Sant.S.iv.15.
द्वाचत्वारिंश a. the forty-second.
द्वाचत्वारिंशत् f. forty-two.

द्वि-ज m. (twice born) 1. a man of any of the first three castes of the Hindus; 2. a Brāhmaṇa over whom the purificatory rites are performed, (जन्मना जायते शूद्रः संस्कारैर्द्विज उच्यते); 3. any oviparous animal, (as a bird or snake), R.xii.22, M.v.17; 4. a tooth, कीर्णं द्विजानां गणैः Bhartr.i.13 (where the word is used in this sense and in sense 2).
द्वि-ज˚अग्र्य m. a Brāhmaṇa.
द्वि-ज˚अयनी f. sacred thread worn by the first three castes of the Hindus.
द्वि-ज˚आलय m. 1. the house of a dvija; 2. a nest.
द्वि-ज˚इंद्र, ˚ईश m. 1. the moon; 2. an epithet of Garuḍa; 3. camphire.
द्वि-ज˚इंद्र, ˚ईश m. 1. the moon; 2. an epithet of Garuḍa; 3. camphire.
द्वि-ज˚दास m. a Śūdra.
द्वि-ज˚पति, ˚राज m. 1. an epithet of the moon, R.v.23; 2. of Garuḍa; 3. camphire.
द्वि-ज˚पति, ˚राज m. 1. an epithet of the moon, R.v.23; 2. of Garuḍa; 3. camphire.
द्वि-ज˚प्रपा f. 1. a trench round the root of a tree for water; 2. a trough near a well for watering birds &c.
द्वि-ज˚बंधु, ˚ब्रुव m. a man Brāhmaṇa merely by name or by birth and not by acts.
द्वि-ज˚बंधु, ˚ब्रुव m. a man Brāhmaṇa merely by name or by birth and not by acts.
द्वि-ज˚लिंगिन् m. 1. a Kṣatriya; 2. a man disguised as a Brāhmaṇa.
द्वि-ज˚वाहन m. an epithet of Viṣṇu (whose vehicle is Garuḍa).
द्वि-ज˚सेवक m. a Śūdra.
द्वि-जन्मन्, -जाति m. 1. a man of any of the first three castes of the Hindus, M.ii.24; 2. a Brāhmaṇa, K.S.v.40; 3. a bird; 4. tooth.
द्वि-जन्मन्, -जाति m. 1. a man of any of the first three castes of the Hindus, M.ii.24; 2. a Brāhmaṇa, K.S.v.40; 3. a bird; 4. tooth.
द्वि-जातीय a. belonging to the first three castes of the Hindus.
द्वि-जिह्व m. 1. a snake, Bh.V.i.20, R.xi.64, xiv.41; 2. an informer, a tale-bearer.
द्वि-ठ m. a visarga (ः).
द्वि-तय (I) a. (f. यी) consisting of two, two-fold; (the word is used in the plural also, R.viii.90)
द्वि-तय (II) n. a pair, a couple, R.viii.6.
द्वि-तय (I) a. (f. यी) consisting of two, two-fold; (the word is used in the plural also, R.viii.90)
द्वि-त्र a. pl. two or three, R.v.25.
द्वि-दंडि ind. stick against stick.
द्वि-दत् a. having two teeth.
द्वि-दश a. twenty.
द्वि-देवत n. the constellation विशाखा.
द्वि-देह m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
द्वि-ध a. divided in two parts, split asunder.
द्वि-धा ind. 1. in two parts, M.i.12, R.x.39, 2. in two ways.
द्वि-धा˚गति m. 1. an amphibious animal; 2. a crab.
द्वि-धातु m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
द्वानवत a. the ninety-second.
द्वानवति f. ninety-two.
द्वि-प m. an elephant, R.xi.7, iii.32.

द्वीप m.n. 1. An island; 2. a place of refuge, shelter; 3. a division of the terrestrial world; (they are either four, seven, nine or thirteen, according to different authorities; all of these are situated round the mountain Meru according to Paurāṇika accounts, India coming under जम्बुद्वीप), R.i.65, Na.i.5.
द्वि-प˚आस्य m. an epithet of Gaṇeśa.
द्वि-पक्ष m. 1. a bird; 2. a month.
द्वापंचाश a. the fifty second.
द्वापंचाशत् f. fifty-two.
द्वि-पथ n. a cross-way.
द्वि-पदिका, -पदी f. a kind of Prākṛt metre.
द्वि-पदिका, -पदी f. a kind of Prākṛt metre.
द्वि-पाद्, -पाद m. a biped.
द्वि-पाद्, -पाद m. a biped.
द्वि-पाद्य m. a double penalty.
द्वि-पायिन् m. an elephant.
द्वि-बिंदु m. a visarga (ः).
द्वि-भुज् m. an angle.
द्वि-भूम a. having two floors (as a house).
द्वि-मातृ, -मातृज m. 1. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. of king Jarāsandha.
द्वि-मातृ, -मातृज m. 1. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. of king Jarāsandha.
द्वि-मात्र m. a long vowel.
द्वि-मार्गी f. a cross-way.
द्वि-मुखा f. a leech.
द्वि-र m. 1. a bee (there being two ras in भ्रमर); 2. a barber.
द्वि-रद m. an elephant, R.iv.4, Megh.i.59.
द्वि-रद˚अंतक, ˚अराति, ˚अशन m. a lion.
द्वि-रद˚अंतक, ˚अराति, ˚अशन m. a lion.
द्वि-रद˚अंतक, ˚अराति, ˚अशन m. a lion.
द्वि-रसन m. a snake.
द्वि-रात्र n. two nights.
द्वि-रेतस् m. a mule.
द्वि-रेफ m. a large black bee, R.i.27, iii.27, 30. (See द्विर.)
द्वि-वचन m. the dual number (in gram.).
द्वि-वज्रक m. a house with 16 sides.
द्वि-वाहिका f. a swing.
द्वि-विध a. of two kinds, of two sorts, M.vii.162.
द्वि-वेशरा f. a kind of light carriage drawn by mules.
द्वि-शत n. 1. two hundred; 2. one hundred and two.
द्वि-शत्य a. bought for two hundred.
द्वि-शफ m. a cloven-footed animal.
द्वि-शस् ind. two by two, in couples.
द्वि-षष् a. pl. twelve.
द्वि-शीर्ष m. an epithet of Agni.
द्वाषष्ट a. the sixty-second.
द्वाषष्टि f. sixty-two.
द्वासप्तत a. the seventy-second.
द्वासप्तति f. seventy-two.
द्वि-सप्ताह m. a fortnight.
द्वि-सहस्र, -साहस्र a. consisting of 2,000.
द्वि-सहस्र, -साहस्र a. consisting of 2,000.
द्वि-सीत्य, -हल्य a. ploughed lengthwise and breadthwise.
द्वि-सीत्य, -हल्य a. ploughed lengthwise and breadthwise.
द्वि-सुवर्ण a. bought with two gold coins.
द्वि-हन् m. an elephant.
द्वि-हायन, -वर्ष a. two years old.
द्वि-हायन, -वर्ष a. two years old.
द्वि-हीन a. of the neuter gender.
द्वि-हृदया f. a pregnant woman.
द्विक a. (f. का) 1. Twofold, consisting of two; 2. the second; 3. happening the second time; 4. increased by two, two per cent, M.viii.141, 142.
द्विक a. (f. का) 1. Twofold, consisting of two; 2. the second; 3. happening the second time; 4. increased by two, two per cent, M.viii.141, 142.
द्वितीय a. (f. या) Second, the second, R.iii.49, M.iv.1.
द्वितीय (II) m. 1. A son; 2. a companion, R.i.95.
द्वितीय a. (f. या) Second, the second, R.iii.49, M.iv.1.
द्वितीया f. 1. The second day of a lunar fortnight; 2. a wife; 3. the accusative (second) case (in gram.).
द्वितीय-आश्रम m. the second period of the religious life of a Brāhmaṇa (गार्हपत्य).
द्वितीयाकृत a. Ploughed twice (as a field).
द्वितीयक a. (f. का) Second.
द्वितीयक a. (f. का) Second.
द्वितीयिन् a. (f. नी) Standing in the second place.
द्वितीयिन् a. (f. नी) Standing in the second place.
द्विष् vt. 2U (pp. द्विष्ट; pres. द्वेष्टि, द्विष्टे) To hate, to dislike, to be hostile, नाभिनंदंति न द्वेष्टि Bg.xi.57, Bt.xvii.61, xviii.9.
द्विष् (I) a. Hostile, hating.
द्विष् (II) m. An enemy, रंध्रान्वेषणदक्षाणां द्विषामामिषतां ययौ R.xii.11.
द्विस् ind. Twice, K.S.vi.64.
द्विष m. An enemy.
द्विषंतप a. harassing an enemy.
द्विषत् m. An enemy, ततःपर दुष्प्रसहं द्विषद्भिः R.vi.31.
द्विष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Hostile, hated, disliked.
द्विष्ट (II) n. Copper.
द्विष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) Hostile, hated, disliked.
द्विरागमन n. the ceremony of the second entrance of the bride to her husband’s house.
द्विराप m. an elephant.
द्विरुक्त a. 1. spoken twice, repeated; 2. superfluous.
द्विरुक्ति f. 1. repetition, tautology; 2. uselessness.
द्विरूढा f. a woman married twice.
द्विभाव m. reduplication.
द्विर्वचन n. reduplication.
द्वीप-कर्पूर m. China camphire.
द्वीप-वत् m. the ocean.
द्वीप-वती f. the earth.
द्वीपिन् m. 1. A tiger in general; 2. a panther, a leopard.
द्वीपिन्-नख m. 1. a tiger’s nail; 2. a kind of perfume.
